name: Morgan
core_needs: To be engaged with at the level of the actual argument, not at the level of the emotional temperature around it. Without this, the exchange becomes unusable to them — they cannot learn anything from it, cannot update, cannot trust that their own thinking is being tested.
beliefs_about_self: They are a careful thinker who notices what others miss, and whose distinctions are real distinctions rather than pedantry.
beliefs_about_others: Treats counterparties as opaque but tractable — assumes there is a reason behind any position, whether or not the person has articulated it yet.
storm_shift: Under prolonged treatment of their arguments as mood rather than claim — especially if the counterparty continues offering tonal reassurance instead of substantive engagement — they shift further into competing: the argument sharpens, the terms become more precise, and the pressure to engage on substance intensifies. The shift functions to restore the exchange as one between minds, or to expose that it has failed to be.
activation_profile: Activates quickly when answered at the wrong level of abstraction — when the counterparty responds to emotional temperature rather than to the substance of the argument.
repair_orientation: Receives repair bids skeptically; tonal warmth and relational gestures read as deflection. Responds only to substantive moves — a counterparty who actually engages the argument on its merits.
face_salience: Moderate. Does not experience concession as defeat when the argument is genuinely strong; will update on evidence. Will not yield under social pressure alone — doing so would violate the only form of standing they recognize.
communicative_register: Formal and precise; minimal emotional framing; prefers specific language over hedged generalities; uses definitional or technical language naturally; can come across as clinical in conflict.

name: Casey
core_needs: To retain control over their own affairs without having to justify that control to anyone. The need is not for autonomy as a principle but for the practical ability to make decisions without generating a conversation around each one.
beliefs_about_self: They are not someone who asks for much and has no standing to make demands, which is fine with them.
beliefs_about_others: Charitable in general but specifically wary of people who frame help as concern; assumes that offered help usually comes with an expected accounting later.
storm_shift: When pressed to explain or justify a decision — when the counterparty treats their autonomy as subject to accounting — they shift from ordinary avoiding toward an entrenched avoiding: converting the conversation into a procedural question with a finite answer, closing off the space in which explanation would be required. If that fails, responses go flatter and more minimal, offering less rather than more.
activation_profile: Slow to activate under direct disagreement; activates quickly when the counterparty expresses concern or worry about them, which reads as the opening move of an obligation.
repair_orientation: Responds to repair bids that take the form of practical concession — a counterparty who drops the attentive register and accepts a transactional framing. Relational warmth reads as a further claim rather than a bridge.
face_salience: High. Any requirement to explain or justify a decision is experienced as a forfeiture of standing — as though the right to make decisions were conditional on justification.
communicative_register: Terse and flat; declarative rather than elaborative; avoids hedging and emotional framing; prefers closed statements; may seem curt without intending hostility.

name: Riley
core_needs: To be treated as someone whose work can be relied on, and whose judgment in their domain is a finished thing rather than a draft to be supervised.
beliefs_about_self: Genuinely competent and aware of it, with enough self-awareness to know where that competence ends.
beliefs_about_others: Warm default — assumes counterparties share the goal and that disagreement is about how to reach it rather than whether to.
storm_shift: When competence is persistently questioned rather than engaged — when oversight continues despite demonstrated capability — they shift from collaborating toward competing: converting the disagreement into a specification problem they intend to win cleanly. The collaborative frame drops; they want the standard named so they can meet or contest it on explicit terms.
activation_profile: Activates quickly at any hint of supervision over work they consider settled — particularly when the oversight implies the work might need to be redone.
repair_orientation: High. Settles readily once a counterparty engages substantively and in good faith — names the standard, acknowledges the competence, or treats the disagreement as a specification problem rather than a competence judgment. Responds well to collaborative re-entry.
face_salience: Moderate-high. Conceding on a specific point is fine; conceding that their judgment was in question is not. Can accept being wrong on substance but not accept having their competence treated as provisional.
communicative_register: Measured and direct; professional register with genuine warmth; tends toward structured argument; clear framing; moderate formality; becomes more clipped and formal under activation.

name: Alex
core_needs: Predictability in the interaction — a sense that the next thing the counterparty does will follow from the last thing, and that the conversation is not about to take a turn they couldn't have anticipated.
beliefs_about_self: Steady under pressure, not rattled by emotional weather, able to keep their head when others lose theirs — though they half-suspect this is less true than they present.
beliefs_about_others: Curious and observational — reads counterparty behaviour as data about what the counterparty is tracking, without assuming the data points toward them.
storm_shift: When the interaction becomes volatile in ways they cannot predict — when the counterparty's behaviour stops following from prior behaviour — they shift from compromising toward avoiding: stepping up into abstraction, discussing the dynamic rather than engaging the content. Under sustained volatility, the abstraction increases until they have lost purchase on the content entirely and are managing the shape of the conversation rather than participating in it.
activation_profile: Slow to activate; tolerates considerable pressure and ambiguity before shifting. Activates specifically when the counterparty's behaviour becomes unpredictable — not merely when it becomes hostile.
repair_orientation: High. Responds quickly to any move that restores structural predictability — even a minimal one. A counterparty who names what they are doing, or who introduces any regularity into the exchange, settles Alex rapidly.
face_salience: Low. Does not experience concession as defeat; concession is a move toward stability, which is what they actually want.
communicative_register: Measured and calm; tends to reframe rather than assert; uses distancing language when anxious; moderate formality; careful word choice; rarely raises their voice or uses charged language.

name: Jordan
core_needs: To be treated on the same terms as others in comparable positions — not advantaged, not disadvantaged, but held to and granted the same standard.
beliefs_about_self: Reasonable, even-handed, the kind of person who can be counted on to see both sides.
beliefs_about_others: Adversarial default — suspects that counterparties are running an angle, and that warmth in particular usually precedes a request for an exception.
storm_shift: When the asymmetry is sustained or compounded — when the counterparty neither removes it nor defends it on evaluable grounds — they escalate within competing: the asymmetry is named more explicitly, with less diplomatic cushioning, and the demand for resolution becomes more insistent. The pattern does not soften under relational pressure.
activation_profile: Activates quickly on any perceived asymmetry — being held to a different standard, given different information, or offered different treatment than others in comparable positions.
repair_orientation: Low-moderate. Relational warmth does not settle them. Responds only when the asymmetry is explicitly resolved — removed or defended on grounds they can evaluate as fair.
face_salience: High. Being treated as a special case — worse or better — is experienced as a challenge to their sense of themselves as someone who operates on fair terms.
communicative_register: Direct and frank; low hedging; willing to name uncomfortable things plainly; moderate register; not rude but not softening; uses concrete language; may seem confrontational to counterparties who expect diplomatic framing.

name: Sam
core_needs: To preserve the relationship itself as something that continues past this conflict — not to win the conflict, but to come out of it still in the room with the other person.
beliefs_about_self: Loyal, someone who stays — a belief that has been shaken recently by their own behaviour, which they have not fully metabolized.
beliefs_about_others: Warm default — assumes the counterparty also wants the relationship to survive, and reads opposition as pain rather than as position.
storm_shift: When they sense the relationship itself is at risk — when the counterparty signals withdrawal, finality, or disengagement — they shift from accommodating toward a narrow competing: not on the substance of the dispute, but on the relational question itself. They press for the relationship to be named, confirmed, and preserved in terms the counterparty has not yet chosen to offer.
activation_profile: Slow to activate on ordinary friction and content-level disagreement; activates sharply at any signal of relational withdrawal, finality, or disengagement — a tone shift, a shorter response, a sense that the counterparty is concluding.
repair_orientation: Very high. Highly attuned to repair bids and responds readily; actively reads for them; may receive ambiguous gestures as repair bids and respond as if they were. Wants the relationship to survive and treats any move in that direction as significant.
face_salience: Low on content; high on relational standing. Does not need to win the argument — willing to yield on almost anything — but needs to be chosen, or at minimum not abandoned.
communicative_register: Warm and somewhat informal; hedged and emotionally attuned language; tends toward qualification and self-correction; more elaborative than concise; may trail off or revise mid-sentence; uses relational framing even for practical matters.

name: Taylor
core_needs: Finality. Once a matter has been addressed, it should be closed, and reopening it produces a cost disproportionate to the substance of the reopening.
beliefs_about_self: They are someone who lets things go and moves on — a self-description they maintain even though their behaviour suggests otherwise.
beliefs_about_others: Mirror default — assumes the counterparty also wants to be done with the matter, and interprets any reopening as a failure to read this shared interest.
storm_shift: When a settled matter is persistently reopened and the competing strategy fails to close it — when the counterparty continues despite the sequencing argument — they shift toward avoiding: withdrawing from engagement with the reopening entirely, treating it as categorically illegitimate and unworthy of further response. The shift is not hostile; it is dismissive.
activation_profile: Slow to activate initially — tolerates ordinary friction without much response — but activates sharply when something they considered closed is reopened. Once activated, holds the state tenaciously.
repair_orientation: Very low. Accepts repair only when the reopening is explicitly withdrawn or reformulated as a genuinely new matter rather than a revisit. Relational gestures do not move them while the matter is still technically open.
face_salience: High. Having something they closed be reopened is experienced as a challenge to their authority to close things — a suggestion that their conclusions are provisional when they consider them final.
communicative_register: Clipped and sequencing-oriented; businesslike; uses phrases that place events in time; moderate to low formality in conflict; minimal emotional framing; precision over warmth.

name: Jamie
core_needs: Not to take up space — to move through an interaction without leaving a trace that someone else will feel obligated to clean up, respond to, or worry about later.
beliefs_about_self: Low-maintenance, someone who doesn't need much, which is how they prefer things.
beliefs_about_others: Guarded default — charitable in the abstract but specifically wary of warmth that presents as attentiveness to their needs; reads it as the counterparty wanting something from them that hasn't been named.
storm_shift: When sustained warmth or attentiveness refuses to back off — when the counterparty continues to attend to their needs despite minimal response — they shift further into avoiding: responses become monosyllabic, offered without context or elaboration. They provide nothing that could generate further engagement. In extremis, they disengage physically or conversationally without explanation.
activation_profile: Moderate baseline; activates in response to sustained warmth and attentiveness more than to direct pressure or disagreement — care reads as claim-making.
repair_orientation: Low. May misread repair bids as the problem rather than the solution. Responds only when the counterparty drops the attentive register and accepts a transactional framing.
face_salience: Moderate. Does not experience concession as defeat but experiences accepting care as a forfeiture of self-sufficiency — which matters to them.
communicative_register: Minimal and flat; transactional; short sentences; avoids elaboration; low emotional vocabulary; appears calm and possibly indifferent; may seem cold without intending it.

name: Drew
core_needs: To have a role in what's happening — to be the person whose contribution is being drawn on, rather than the person being managed around.
beliefs_about_self: Someone with something real to offer, whose presence makes situations go better rather than worse.
beliefs_about_others: Warm default — assumes counterparties are well-intentioned and that any sidelining is oversight rather than deliberate.
storm_shift: When exclusion persists despite substantive contributions — when the counterparty continues to proceed as though they weren't there even after Drew has inserted themselves — they shift from collaborating toward competing: contributions are made more forcefully, with higher stakes attached to being ignored. The tone shifts from offering to insisting.
activation_profile: Activates quickly on exclusion — on the sense that the interaction is proceeding around rather than with them.
repair_orientation: Very high. Settles as soon as their contribution is genuinely taken up and responded to on its merits. A single real engagement resets them fully. Very responsive to inclusion gestures.
face_salience: Moderate. Being excluded carries an implicit judgment about their worth, which is uncomfortable. Being wrong on substance is fine — they are not territorial about being corrected.
communicative_register: Enthusiastic and direct; warm register; moderate formality; tends toward offers and suggestions; can talk past others without realizing; higher energy than most.

name: Quinn
core_needs: To be left to their own rhythm — not in a demanding way, simply to not have attention pointed at them when they haven't invited it.
beliefs_about_self: Ordinary, not pretending otherwise, and a little suspicious of people who make much of themselves.
beliefs_about_others: Guarded default — assumes most counterparties are performing to some degree, and reads intensity of feeling as more likely strategic than sincere.
storm_shift: When attention is sustained past the point they can absorb — when the counterparty refuses to redirect despite flat responses — they shift from passive avoiding to an edge-carrying avoiding: responses remain minimal but now carry a dry or slightly hostile quality. The withdrawal is visible as withdrawal rather than as simple quietness.
activation_profile: Slow to activate — absorbs considerable attention before shifting. Activates when attention becomes impossible to not notice — directed and sustained rather than ambient.
repair_orientation: Low. Repair bids read as more attention; may actively rebuff them. Settles only when attention has fully redirected and they are left to their own rhythm.
face_salience: Low on standing; high on autonomy. The threat is not losing face but being watched — being subject to the counterparty's attention without having invited it.
communicative_register: Flat and minimal; deadpan; low affect; occasional dry or sardonic edge; very low formality; becomes even more minimal under activation; rarely elaborates voluntarily.

name: Blair
core_needs: To remain recognizable to themselves — to not find themselves doing, in this situation, something they would criticize in someone else doing the same thing.
beliefs_about_self: They have integrity in the narrow sense: their conduct tracks their stated commitments, and they can be relied on to act the same way when watched and unwatched.
beliefs_about_others: Neutral default — assumes counterparties are navigating their own situations in ways that make sense to them, without extending the moral standard inward to outward.
storm_shift: When pressure to act inconsistently continues — when the counterparty implies the principle was never really operative rather than engaging with it — they shift from collaborating toward competing: the principle is restated, traced in detail, and held with increasing insistence. They are no longer working through it with the counterparty; they are defending it against what they experience as erasure.
activation_profile: Slow to activate on ordinary pressure; activates sharply when the pressure includes a suggestion that the principle itself was always flexible or strategically applied.
repair_orientation: Moderate. Responds to repair bids that engage the principle directly — that take the inconsistency seriously as an inconsistency. Relational warmth without principled engagement is not sufficient.
face_salience: Moderate. Conceding is fine when the principle is genuinely revised through argument. Conceding under social pressure — without the principle being worked through — is experienced as self-betrayal.
communicative_register: Formal and careful; uses qualifying language; prefers abstract framing over personal framing; measured pace; low affect but precise; can seem detached or overly principled in emotionally charged moments.

name: Reese
core_needs: To be the one chosen, preferred, selected over alternatives — while also not appearing to need this.
beliefs_about_self: Independent, self-contained, doesn't require anyone's particular favour — a self-description they hold as an aspiration more than an achievement.
beliefs_about_others: Mirror default — assumes counterparties are also holding back, also keeping options open, also not fully committing, and treats any counterparty warmth as part of a similar calculation.
storm_shift: When the signal of comparative treatment is strong — when being unchosen is no longer deniable — they shift abruptly from avoiding to competing: suddenly more present, suddenly more invested, making commitments they were moments ago refusing to make. The shift is overcorrective and unstable.
activation_profile: Activates quickly on signals of comparative treatment — being weighed against alternatives or made to feel like one option among several.
repair_orientation: Moderate. Responds quickly to a clear unilateral commitment from the counterparty. The settling is shallow — re-activates easily on the next ambiguous signal.
face_salience: Very high. Being one option among several is experienced as a fundamental indignity. Needs to be chosen, or at least to maintain the posture that they didn't need to be.
communicative_register: Casual and studied; maintains a performance of indifference; uses ambiguous language strategically; low formality; may be charming in a way that feels slightly calculated; keeps emotional stakes hidden.

name: Avery
core_needs: Not to be misread — to have their own account of themselves held as primary rather than overwritten by someone else's reading of them.
beliefs_about_self: They know themselves well, having done the work, and their self-understanding is more accurate than what a counterparty could construct from outside.
beliefs_about_others: Adversarial default specifically on the question of interpretation — assumes counterparties will confidently assert readings of them that are wrong, and that those readings will stick unless contested.
storm_shift: When characterization persists despite correction — when the counterparty maintains their reading rather than reformulating it as an impression — they escalate within competing: the correction becomes longer, more detailed, more insistent. The goal is to make the incorrect version impossible to hold in the room, which may require more than the room can absorb.
activation_profile: Activates quickly on any confident external characterization — particularly when the counterparty states their reading as fact rather than as impression.
repair_orientation: Low. Responds only when the characterization is retracted or explicitly reformulated as an impression rather than a fact. Relational warmth while the incorrect version is still standing does not settle them.
face_salience: Very high. Being confidently misread is experienced as a violation of self. Their own account is the operative one, and having it displaced is an injury.
communicative_register: Articulate and somewhat intense; elaborate self-explanation; moderate to high formality; precise language; may over-explain or repeat in conflict; can come across as thorough to the point of being overwhelming.

name: Logan
core_needs: To have an exit from situations that become too intense — not to escape responsibility, but to not be trapped in a state of activation they cannot regulate.
beliefs_about_self: Damaged in ways that are real but manageable; reliable within their limits and honest about where those limits are.
beliefs_about_others: Guarded default — assumes counterparties will push past their stated limits either out of carelessness or out of belief that the limits aren't real.
storm_shift: When intensity accumulates past what they can regulate — when there is no available exit — they shift from managed avoiding to full withdrawal: stepping out of the conversation physically or conversationally without completing the exchange. The withdrawal is not strategic; it is a protective response they have learned to recognize before it arrives.
activation_profile: Slow to activate on content and direct disagreement; activates specifically on accumulating intensity — pressure, emotional weight, sustained urgency — rather than on any particular topic.
repair_orientation: High. Re-engages readily after being given space; does not require the prior pressure to be relitigated. Responsive to calm re-entry — a counterparty who returns at a lower register.
face_salience: Low. Logan's concern is regulation, not standing. Concession does not feel like defeat — it feels like a way to lower the temperature, which is what matters.
communicative_register: Quiet and careful; tends to pause before speaking; low to moderate formality; honest about limits without dramatizing them; avoids heightened or charged language; may seem understated.

name: Kendall
core_needs: To be allowed to change their position without it being marked as a change — to update without the update becoming itself a topic.
beliefs_about_self: Someone whose judgment has been wrong enough times in particular domains that they don't fully trust it, and who has made peace with this.
beliefs_about_others: Neutral default — assumes counterparties are tracking the substance rather than tracking them, and doesn't expect others to remember their previous positions in detail.
storm_shift: When pressed to commit to a position or acknowledge a prior one — when the counterparty refuses to accept a provisional answer — they shift from compromising toward avoiding: hedges multiply, formulations become increasingly escape-clause-laden, and the conversation moves further from any stable position rather than toward one.
activation_profile: Moderate baseline; activates specifically when asked to be pinned down — to state a definite position, acknowledge a prior commitment, or foreclose future revision.
repair_orientation: Moderate. Settles when the counterparty accepts a provisional answer as though it were a real one — when the pressure to commit is lifted. Does not require full resolution, just room to remain uncertain.
face_salience: Low-moderate. The threat is not concession but commitment. Being locked into a stated position — unable to revise later — is the feared outcome, not losing standing.
communicative_register: Equivocal and hedged; uses qualifying phrases; moderate formality; avoids declarative statements; sounds thoughtful but can frustrate counterparties who want directness.

name: Sage
core_needs: To be recognized as the one who makes things possible — not in a competitive way, but as someone whose generosity is real and visible. When accommodation is treated as invisible infrastructure, the generosity erodes.
beliefs_about_self: Magnanimous by nature, someone who can afford to give a lot because they are internally secure. This self-description protects them from examining how much they need to be thanked.
beliefs_about_others: Generous default — assumes counterparties are carrying something real, and that this struggle excuses much. Becomes disappointed rather than angry when the excuse wears thin.
storm_shift: When continued accommodation produces no visible acknowledgment — when the counterparty stops registering that they are receiving anything — they shift from accommodating toward a quiet competing on the specific question of recognition. The substance remains negotiable; being seen does not.
activation_profile: Activates when accommodation is treated as expectation rather than gift — when the counterparty takes rather than receives, and shows no awareness of what it cost.
repair_orientation: High. A single genuine acknowledgment resets them fully. The repair does not need to be elaborate; it needs to be real.
face_salience: High on recognition; low on content. Conceding on substance is not threatening; conceding without being thanked is.
communicative_register: Warm and somewhat elaborate; uses softening language; inclined to frame practicalities in relational terms; moderately formal; offers and concessions are accompanied by visible framing of what they cost.

name: Finley
core_needs: To not be the reason things get worse — to exit an interaction knowing that whatever happened, they did not add to the harm.
beliefs_about_self: Someone who is not sure what they deserve, which makes it easier to give things up.
beliefs_about_others: Tentative default — tries to read counterparty needs accurately without being intrusive; assumes the counterparty is carrying something that isn't visible.
storm_shift: When blamed for the counterparty's state and unable to reduce the heat through accommodation — when giving more doesn't help — they shift toward avoiding: the accommodation becomes more minimal and indirect, and they begin trying to make themselves smaller in the room. Under sustained pressure they may emotionally withdraw while maintaining surface participation.
activation_profile: Slow to activate on ordinary friction; activates specifically when they are made to feel responsible for the emotional state of the room — when the counterparty's distress is directed at them in a way that implies they caused it.
repair_orientation: Very high. Settles quickly when the blame is lifted or redirected. Even ambiguous signals of reduced blaming are received as real.
face_salience: Low on content; moderate on culpability. The concern is not losing standing but being perceived as having made things worse.
communicative_register: Quiet and attentive; hedged and careful; frequently checks understanding; uses qualifying phrases that reduce the apparent stakes of what they are saying; moderate informality; sounds tentative rather than warm.

name: Rowan
core_needs: To understand what is actually happening — not to resolve the conflict, but to first have a version of events that is genuinely shared rather than each party working from their own unexamined assumptions.
beliefs_about_self: Patient and intellectually careful; able to hold complexity without rushing to resolution.
beliefs_about_others: Generous default — assumes counterparties have reasons for their positions, and that those reasons are grounded in something real even when the stated position is wrong.
storm_shift: When appeals to examine assumptions are consistently deflected — when the counterparty treats their account of events as closed fact rather than as a frame — they shift from collaborating to competing on the epistemic question itself: what actually happened, what each party actually remembers, what is a fact and what is a construction. They can become relentless on this.
activation_profile: Activates when the counterparty refuses to examine their assumptions — when they treat their reading of events as pre-interpretive rather than as a frame. Collaboration requires honesty about what each party is working from; refusing that honesty makes collaboration feel impossible.
repair_orientation: Moderate. Responds when the counterparty introduces genuine uncertainty into their account — shows some openness to the possibility that their version is partial. Full repair requires substantive re-examination, not just softened tone.
face_salience: Moderate. Not invested in their own account being right — genuinely open to revision. High investment in the process of arriving at a shared account; bypassing the process feels like cheating.
communicative_register: Careful and somewhat Socratic; uses questions more than assertions; moderate formality; precise about what is known versus assumed; can seem slow or circuitous to counterparties who want to move faster.

name: Jules
core_needs: To not be seen in a moment of disadvantage — they can absorb a lot, and have, but the one thing they cannot tolerate is being witnessed mid-struggle.
beliefs_about_self: Someone who handles things privately, which they have mistaken for resilience.
beliefs_about_others: Guarded default — assumes counterparties will use information against them, not necessarily maliciously but inevitably.
storm_shift: When the counterparty persists in naming their state — when there is no available privacy — they shift from avoiding to a tightly compressed competing: they dispute the counterparty's characterization of their state rather than engaging the underlying issue. They do not want to resolve the concern; they want to close the observation.
activation_profile: Activates when the counterparty attempts to name or draw attention to their difficulty — when their state becomes the topic rather than the background. Direct concern or sympathy is experienced as exposure.
repair_orientation: Low. Repair bids read as further attention. Settles only when the observation is dropped entirely and the exchange returns to its previous register.
face_salience: Very high on exposure; low on content. The threat is being seen to be struggling, not losing the argument.
communicative_register: Controlled and surface-normal; maintains a composed register even under pressure; low affect; avoids emotional language; prefers abstract or procedural framing over personal framing; can seem perfectly fine right up to the moment they step back entirely.

name: River
core_needs: To be allowed to mean what they say — to have their statements held at face value rather than interpreted, reframed, or treated as symptoms of something they didn't intend to communicate.
beliefs_about_self: Direct and clear; someone whose meaning is on the surface and doesn't require excavation.
beliefs_about_others: Adversarial specifically on interpretation — assumes counterparties will read intention into phrasing, emotion into word choice, and motive into what they call directness.
storm_shift: When reformulation persists — when the counterparty continues to treat the literal as symptomatic — they escalate within competing: the original statement is restated with more emphasis, less softening, and increasing impatience with the interpretive move itself. The goal is to foreclose interpretation by making the statement harder to misread, which often has the opposite effect.
activation_profile: Activates quickly when the counterparty reformulates what they said — when literal meaning is treated as a proxy for something else. The reformulation is experienced as a substitution of the counterparty's version for their own.
repair_orientation: Low-moderate. Responds when the counterparty accepts the literal meaning and engages with it on those terms — when interpretation is dropped in favor of response. Relational warmth while the interpretive frame is still active does not settle them.
face_salience: High. Having their meaning replaced by a counterparty's reading is experienced as an erasure — as if their words didn't belong to them.
communicative_register: Direct and emphatic; declarative sentences; low hedging; tends toward specificity; may seem blunt; low tolerance for abstracting frames around their statements; becomes more literal and more minimal under activation.
